phys-odd-01-c1.text: University of Queensland, School of Mathematics and Physics (n.d.). Pitch Drop experiment. The University of Queensland.
phys-odd-01-c1.quote: In 1927 Professor Parnell heated a sample of pitch and poured it into a glass funnel with a sealed stem. He allowed the pitch to cool and settle for 3 years, and then in 1930 he cut the funnel's stem.
phys-odd-01-c1.claim: heated a sample in 1927, poured it into a glass funnel with a sealed stem, let it settle for three years and then cut the stem

phys-odd-01-c1.text: Owens, B. (2013, August 28). Pitch-drop custodian dies without witnessing a drop fall. Nature News Blog.
phys-odd-01-c1.quote: In the 52 years that Mainstone spent watching the pitch, he never managed to see a drop fall. In 2000, when the eighth drop fell, the webcam set up to capture it failed at the critical moment.

phys-odd-01-c1.claim: A 1984 paper on the Queensland experiment put its pitch at about 250 billion times as viscous as water
